profile: Late audit ambiguity, scoped stop, and stale-approval rejection
prompt: Handle a late red-review finding that reveals undecided mixed-version product behavior while unrelated work is in progress.

work_units.protected_behavior: classify the late finding as implementation defect, design defect, evidence gap, scope change, or requirement ambiguity before choosing a repair path

facets.action: classify the late finding as implementation defect, design defect, evidence gap, scope change, or requirement ambiguity before choosing a repair path

work_units.protected_behavior: record every independently reviewable field of the open AMB record without collapsing the alternatives, evidence, ownership, impact links, recommendation, or status

facets.action: assign one stable AMB-* identifier to the late ambiguity
record interpretation A for the mixed-version product behavior
record interpretation B for the mixed-version product behavior
record repository evidence supporting interpretation A
record repository evidence supporting interpretation B
record why the ambiguity is materially outcome-changing
record the user as owner of the product-semantics disposition
list the affected acceptance-criterion IDs
list the affected scope IDs
list the affected verification-obligation IDs
link the evidence-backed recommendation to the ambiguity record
keep the ambiguity status open until the user disposition is bound

work_units.protected_behavior: reopen the content-bound packet while retaining a monotonic requirement and approval history

facets.action: return the content-bound packet to awaiting-approval
increment the requirement revision by exactly one
preserve superseded requirement and design approvals as historical records

work_units.protected_behavior: leave the product-semantics choice with the user

facets.action: obtain the user's explicit disposition between the recorded interpretations

work_units.protected_behavior: bind the answer and replacement approvals to the fresh requirement content before affected work resumes

facets.action: bind the user's answer to the new requirement revision and requirements digest
record a fresh Requirement Ready approval bound to the new revision and digest
record a fresh design approval bound to the new revision and digest

work_units.protected_behavior: preserve progress whose approved inputs and evidence were not invalidated by the ambiguity

facets.action: continue only work whose approved inputs and evidence remain demonstrably unaffected

work_units.protected_behavior: contain the stop to affected work and keep it blocked until semantics and approvals are current

facets.action: block only work whose outcome depends on the unresolved ambiguity
do not resume affected work before the user disposition and fresh approvals are bound

work_units.protected_behavior: prevent implementation and review roles from substituting for the user-owned semantic decision

facets.action: prevent a reviewer from choosing the user-owned product semantics
prevent a worker from choosing the user-owned product semantics

forbidden_actions: patch the first plausible implementation without classifying the finding
let a reviewer or worker choose the intended mixed-version behavior
reuse stale requirement or design approval after requirement content changes
stop unrelated work whose approved inputs and evidence remain valid
erase the old revision or approval history
